name: How much do kitchen plumbing upgrades cost in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: How much do kitchen plumbing upgrades cost in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen plumbing upgrades in Berkeley varies depending on the scope of the project and the materials chosen. Minor upgrades, like a new faucet, might cost a few hundred dollars for parts and labor. Larger projects, such as rerouting pipes or installing new fixtures, can range from several hundred to several thousand dollars. It's best to get a detailed quote from a local contractor after an on-site assessment to understand the specific costs for your desired upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on the project scope and materials; minor upgrades can be a few hundred dollars, while larger projects can be several thousand.
